description: This file defines a PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_StyleAttribute' that extends 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule'. It sets up a module related to style attributes within an HTML Purifier library, configuring attribute collections and setup routines for style handling.
